what_to_do.en: Tap the word with the right capital.

stages.choice_rule: Four unique writings of one target word. Exactly one follows the rule: first-letter capital only for a day, month, or holiday name; all lowercase for a season or a common time word (today, morning, weekend, night, birthday, or the words day, month, holiday). The other three are all-lowercase when the target needs a capital, all-caps, first-letter capital when the target must stay lowercase, and mixed inner capitals. Never use four different words. Never use may, march, or fall as the target.

gold_items.stem: We go home at this time.
The kids visit after that holiday.
We eat pie after that holiday.

roots: Always four unique forms of one target word, never four different words.
Exactly one choice is correctly capitalized.
Days, months, and holiday names take a first-letter capital only, never all-caps or mixed inner caps.
Seasons and common time words stay all lowercase: today, morning, weekend, night, birthday, and the words day, month, holiday.
Never use may, march, or fall as the target; those words are ambiguous.
Holiday targets may come only from allowed_extra_words.
Kid world only: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands and no real names.
Mix answer_index so the right form is not always first.
Do not describe a picture in the stem.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words. Target is a clear weekday, a clear month, or a common time word like today. Distractors are lowercase, ALL CAPS, and mixed caps of that same word. Add a picture lemma when the scene is concrete.
tier_rules.2: Grade-level stems of five to seven words. Mix weekdays, months, and holiday names from allowed extras. Keep the four-form choice pattern. One gold-style item may use <NAME>.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss time words. Seasons stay lowercase. Birthday and the word holiday stay lowercase. Holiday names still take a first-letter capital only. Avoid may, march, and fall.

day_capital.en: Day names need a capital. Write Monday, not monday.
day_capital.ko: 요일 이름에는 대문자가 필요합니다. monday가 아니라 Monday입니다.

month_capital.en: Month names need a capital. Write April, not april.
month_capital.ko: 월 이름에는 대문자가 필요합니다. april이 아니라 April입니다.

holiday_capital.en: Holiday names need a capital. Write Halloween, not halloween.
holiday_capital.ko: 공휴일 이름에는 대문자가 필요합니다. halloween이 아니라 Halloween입니다.

no_capital_time.en: Words like today and morning do not need a capital.
no_capital_time.ko: today나 morning 같은 낱말에는 대문자가 필요하지 않습니다.

no_capital_season.en: Season names do not need a capital. Write summer, not Summer.
no_capital_season.ko: 계절 이름에는 대문자가 필요하지 않습니다. Summer가 아니라 summer입니다.

no_capital_common.en: The words day, month, and holiday do not need a capital.
no_capital_common.ko: day, month, holiday라는 낱말에는 대문자가 필요하지 않습니다.

no_capital_birthday.en: The word birthday is not a holiday name, so it needs no capital.
no_capital_birthday.ko: birthday는 공휴일 이름이 아니므로 대문자가 필요하지 않습니다.
